author: Bellular News
description:
Europe is investigating Minecraft, Valorant, Diablo Immortal and more over their in-game currencies. The industry offered clearer prices and refunds, but regulators still want more. The fight now rests on a much bigger question: should virtual currency count as real money, and what would that mean for everyone who plays?
